title: Study of Eye Movement Testing and Therapy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the ability of several eye movement monitors, used in clinical practice, to identify children with poor reading eye movements. A second purpose of the study is to evaluate the effectiveness of eye movement therapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children ages 8 to 13 with saccadic eye movement deficit

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous saccadic eye movement therapy
